name: Gaurav Rai
headline: AI, Data and Cloud Analyst and Engineer
summary: Analyst with more than six years across contact centres, IT support, reporting and cloud. At Bendigo Telco I rebuilt CX reporting in SQL and Power BI and took WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram on Amazon Connect to production. I led fifteen agents to lift CSAT from 82% to 91% and build daily with Claude Code and Codex. Melbourne based, available now.
